# Disagreement Log — Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 36

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Chapter:** SHE 036 — Mandate 6.2 (Discerning the Two Spirits)
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

### 1. V. 3 — "long-suffering" vs. "patient" for makrothumos
- **EMET:** "long-suffering"
- **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "patient"
- **Decision:** "patient" — makrothumos can be "long-suffering" but "patient" is more natural; "long-suffering" is preserved elsewhere in the Shepherd where it is more distinct

### 2. V. 3 — "vain desire of this age" vs. "futile worldly desire" vs. "empty desires of this world"
- **EMET:** "vain desire of this age"
- **LOGOS:** "futile worldly desire"
- **PNEUMA:** "empty desires of this world"
- **Decision:** "futile desire of this age" — kenē epithumia = empty/vain desire; "of this age" (aionos) is the standard temporal eschatological phrase

### 3. V. 6 — "weak like winter grass" — all three agree on this image; preserved

### 4. V. 7 — "zealous in strength" vs. "vigorous and strong" vs. "vigorous and strong"
- **EMET:** "zealous in strength and of upright character"
- **LOGOS:** "vigorous and strong, upright in character"
- **PNEUMA:** "vigorous and strong, with genuine character"
- **Decision:** "vigorous and strong, upright in character" — LOGOS; zōtikos = full of life/vigorous; "zealous in strength" is slightly off

### 5. V. 4 — "great understanding" — all three agree
- Unanimous; no disagreement

**Total disagreements: 3**
